author: jessica
source: his 2026-10-23: the military family ("like 10 missionboard missions for Military Dungeons"), "we have droppods, those would be cool", 13:35 "don't limit ourselves by what's there already in my mod, we can add the markers needed later", 13:44 "go for it"
_note: THE MILITARY FAMILY, 5 OF ~10: THE CAPTURED PILOT.
A pilot came down near the site and was taken in. Take the guard captain, open the holding cell from its terminal,
and talk her out. The verb is FREE. She is funnier about it than anyone else would be.
Written to the delve marker set (outside entrance, centre, item markers, boss, wounded) on his ruling, so the
lint pool is EMPTY on military sites until the markers are on them (missionboard06a's note says why).
Every word holds at any military site: nothing names the site, the faction or the weather; everything the lines
point at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Military sites; the family's marker set.

prose.name: Rescue: Captured Pilot on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A pilot set down near the <Place> to wait out a fault, and whoever holds it took her inside. She is still alive.
prose.card: Local Contract. One of our pilots is held at the <Place> on <Planet>. Recover her alive. Payment on contract completion.

beats.objective: Defeat the guard captain at the <Place>
beats.journal: I've dealt with the guard captain at the <Place>. Now I need to find the terminal that opens the pilot's cell.
say: That one was in charge. Her cell runs off their terminal, so open it.

beats.journal: I opened the cell from the terminal. The pilot is free, and I need to talk to her.
beats.name: Holding Cell Terminal

beats.journal: A pilot was taken at the <Place>. I killed the guard captain, opened her cell, and she went to see about her ship.

person.name: Ines Varga
hellos: If you're here to feed me again, I'll pass.

greeting: You're not one of them. They never opened that door without shouting first. I set down to fix a coolant fault.

exchanges.prompt: Let's get you out of here.
reply: Yes. Please. And if my ship's still out there, I'm taking it. Coolant fault and all.
Not really. They mostly argued about what I was worth. The number kept going down. That was the worst part.

exchanges.prompt: Why set down here at all?
reply: The fault picked the spot, not me. I'd have liked somewhere quieter.

beats._talk: Exchange 0 ends the talk and sets stage 100, which pays 'reward'. Every prompt stands on the greeting. Voice 'Megan', irish, unused so far.

broadcast: Our pilot's in there somewhere, and they'll keep her near whoever's in charge. Bring her home. The ship I can replace.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Not yet heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
